# Meet — P2P video meeting

Anonymous, room-code-based, peer-to-peer (WebRTC) video meeting.

## Architecture
- `frontend/` — static site (Vite + TS), built to `docs/` at repo root, served via GitHub Pages at `meet.itsash.in`. Landing page creates/joins a 4-character room code (`meet.itsash.in/xxxx`). Client-side signaling protocol/state machine runs in a Rust→WASM module (`frontend/wasm-signal/`, built with `wasm-pack`, output copied into `frontend/src/wasm/` — gitignored, regenerated by `make build`). Actual audio/video uses native browser WebRTC (`RTCPeerConnection`), STUN-only, no TURN.
- `worker/` — Cloudflare Worker + one Durable Object per room (`RoomSignal`), deployed to `signal.itsash.in`. Purely a WebSocket relay for SDP/ICE between exactly two peers; a DO alarm discards the room if no second peer joins within 5s. No media ever touches this Worker.

## Conventions
- Root `Makefile`: `run` / `build` / `deploy` only, coordinating both sub-projects (see Makefile itself).
- `docs/` at repo root is the GitHub Pages publish directory — regenerated by `make build`, committed on deploy. GitHub Pages is configured manually in repo settings (Pages → deploy from `docs/` on `main`); no GitHub Actions deploy workflow.
- `frontend/src/wasm/` is build output (gitignored) — never hand-edit, regenerate via `wasm-pack build --target web` from `frontend/wasm-signal/`.
- Both `frontend/` and `worker/` are independent Node projects with their own `package.json`; `worker/wrangler.jsonc` binds the `RoomSignal` Durable Object and routes `signal.itsash.in`.
